$description: Code colors the design system adds to the Figma library's global.text.code (Code foundation): diff, invalid code and links, and the line states of highlighted code. Not in the Figma library: added by the design system, from colors it already has (to backport to the Figma library). Text colors alias palette steps, with their dark value in tokens/additions/modes/dark/code.tokens.json; line backgrounds alias the subtle fills, which carry their own dark value.

inserted.$description: Lines a diff adds. The on-base success text step.

deleted.$description: Lines a diff removes. The step of error text on tinted fills: on-base error (error 500) is 4.26:1 on level 1.

changed.$description: Lines a context diff changes. The on-base severe text step.

invalid.$description: Code a grammar marks invalid or deprecated. Same step as deleted.

link.$description: URLs and links in code and markup. The on-base brand text step.

code.$description: Backgrounds of marked lines in a block of code. Each one also carries a marker (+, -, a bar): never color alone.

highlighted.$description: A line the author points out.
